title: observability: token-level metrics + tracing dashboards and alert tuning
author: Priya Ramanathan
description: Context: We need finer-grained visibility into per-token cost and latency to diagnose quality vs. cost regressions and to improve routing/batching heuristics. This PR introduces token-level metrics, KV-cache-specific metrics, tracing annotations, Grafana dashboards, and tuned alert rules to reduce noisy incidents. Motivation: previous incidents (see ENG-7842) surfaced that aggregated request-level metrics hide important distributional shifts (e.g. long tail token generation causing high per-token cost). Goals: 1) capture per-token latency/cost histograms and percentiles, 2) add KV cache hit/miss/latency metrics annotated to traces, 3) ship a Grafana dashboard for SRE/Platform with per-model and per-route breakdowns, 4) tune alert thresholds and add anomaly suppression to reduce false positives. Summary of changes: - telemetry/metrics/token_metrics.go: new Prometheus counters/gauges/histograms for token_latency_ms, token_cost_units, token_size_bytes, kv_cache_hit_rate, kv_cache_latency_ms. Labels: model, route, customer_tier, quantization_profile. - tracing/annotations.go: add span tags for token_index, kv_cache_hit, batch_size; propagate to Tempo/Jaeger. - observability/dashboards/token_level_dashboard.jsonnet: Grafana dashboard with panels for token latency p50/p95/p99, token cost per model, kv cache hit-rate heatmap, per-route token distribution, and correlation panels (tokens vs latency vs cost). - observability/alerting/token_alerts.yaml: new alerts with tuned thresholds and noise reduction (aggregation windows, min_samples, and anomaly suppression via moving-average baseline). - docs/observability/token-metrics.md: guide for interpreting token-level dashboards and suggested remediation steps. - console/routes/token-metrics-view.tsx: add a shortcut to open model/token dashboards from the Console. Testing and rollout: added unit tests for metrics exposition and integration tests that validate labels and cardinality guards. Dashboard JSON serialized and linted with grafonnet lint. Rollout plan: feature gated behind feature flag observability.token_level.v1; enabled for internal orgs first, then gradual rollout to 10% of production traffic for 48h, monitor alerts. Checklist: - [x] Add metrics and tracing annotations - [x] Grafana dashboard + panels - [x] Alert tuning + suppression rules - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Docs and Console link - [x] Feature-flagged rollout Notes: We intentionally avoid high-cardinality labels (no raw request_id or prompt text) and limit label values for quantization_profile and model to known enums. Also added a sampling policy for token-level traces to reduce storage: 1% baseline sampling with 100% sampling for traces that trigger alerts. Related: ENG-7842 (investigation), ENG-7890 (dashboard request).

release_notes: Add token-level observability: new metrics (token_latency_ms, token_cost_units, kv_cache metrics), Grafana dashboard, and tuned alerts. Feature gated behind observability.token_level.v1. SRE: review cardinality allowlists and adjust alert thresholds per team.
notes_for_ops: Feature flag observability.token_level.v1. Start with internal orgs then 10% rollout. Monitor token_cost_units and token_latency_ms p95/p99 for first 48 hours. Be prepared to mute new token-level alerts for low-volume routes via observability.alerts.opt_out tag.
